checks.name: mcp_stdio_domain_contract
checks.result: 10 stdio tests passed against the actual awr-mcp process: exactly eight compact tools; current SDK client and 2025-11-25 negotiation; structured JSON/text/error behavior; all five reads preserve every database table and source bytes; changed files, directory sources and mappings require explicit reindex; context gaps, budgets and branch isolation; source action lifecycle, owned claims, fingerprint/revision conflicts, report hash validation, completion receipts and claim release; generic event reservation, inert evidence commands, duplicate evidence, startup and snapshot limits.

checks.name: search_service_compatibility
checks.result: 2 existing store search tests passed, covering ranked/versioned structured and FTS results, and exclusion of source bodies, credentials, code and long-tail text. Total: 12 distinct tests passed.

checks.name: workspace_build_format
checks.result: Locked all-target workspace check, CLI/MCP build, formatting and diff whitespace checks passed. Only the pre-existing unused meta/commit store test fixture warning appeared.

checks.name: domain_adapter_review
checks.result: Reviewed fixed project binding, eight schemas, domain-service reuse, source-check-only memory snapshots, live revision recheck, mandatory revision and completion evidence bindings, structured error/partial proposal preservation, branch selectors and no shell/report execution. Source work actions retain fingerprint-first behavior; event/evidence source refresh can retain reindex progress while rejecting a stale expected revision.

limitations: Feature-local verification and development self-use only; agent-specific adapters, centralized regression/security, real-client E4 scenarios, metrics and release remain scheduled.
This is a project-bound local stdio server. Session/claim/branch lifecycle and detailed drill-down remain CLI operations so the MCP catalog stays at eight tools.

Readonly requests use a private SQLite memory snapshot capped at 256 MiB, with source observations before/after and a live project revision check. The memory/search scaling targets are not yet benchmarked.
Evidence registration stores caller assertions. Only the existing completion domain validates referenced report bytes and bindings; neither metadata nor tests certify E4 business quality.
Cancellation or loss of a transport response does not prove a mutation rolled back; inspect durable receipts before retrying.
